title: Caap places all airports on heightened alert for Undas 2026

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (Caap) has placed all airports nationwide on heightened alert status due to the expected surge of passengers during Undas. According to Caap, the alert status will take effect starting Thursday, Oct. 29 to Nov. 3, Tuesday, as part of the Department of Transportation’s ‘Oplan Byaheng Ayos: Undas 2026’ initiatives. The agency said it will install help desks across all airports to help passengers with any concerns. It added that all airport security personnel and medical teams are on standby to respond to emergencies. READ: Naia logs almost 300,000 passengers ahead of […]...
